text: Implement a fail-closed Codex adapter for autonomy benchmark v2 fixtures
description: Add a v2 adapter that consumes only FROZEN_AUTONOMY_V2_TASKS, creates a fresh disposable workspace per task and condition, writes every declared initial file plus immutable TASK/expected/verifier files, and injects graphContext only for graph_grounded. Reuse the shell-free ephemeral workspace-write/no-network Codex JSONL launcher and authoritative telemetry parser. Independently verify every expected file, protect all non-mutable fixture inputs and verifier artifacts from changes, reject unexpected files, malformed telemetry, nonzero exits, aborts, tampering, and budget overruns, then clean up. Add deterministic tests for multi-file success, protected evidence, graph isolation, unexpected files, telemetry/budget failure, and all four fixture IDs. Do not launch live v2 agents.

reflections.context: The frozen v2 protocol needed executable multi-file isolation before any live comparison.
reflections.outcome: Implemented CodexAutonomyBenchmarkV2Adapter with fresh disposable workspaces, condition-only graph injection, least-authority shell-free Codex invocation, authoritative JSONL telemetry, external timing, immutable task/evidence/verifier protection, unexpected-file detection, independent verification of every expected file, budget failure, and cleanup. All four v2 fixture IDs pass deterministic adapter execution.
reflections.effectiveness: The adapter preserves the v2 protocol boundary and detects protected evidence tampering plus extra files. Verification: 117/117 package tests, tsc --noEmit, and git diff --check pass. No live v2 model calls occurred.
reflections.lesson: For multi-file benchmarks, mutable scope and expected state must be separate: unchanged evidence can be part of expected output while still being protected from the agent.
reflections.pattern: Generate independent verification from a frozen expected-file manifest and protect every non-mutable input.

valueRationale: The new preregistration cannot produce empirical evidence until its richer fixtures can be executed and independently verified under identical isolation.
